Attached: 1 image

The hailstorm last week pushed several Swiss insurance claim portals to their limits. ⛈️

Portals were temporarily overloaded or unreachable.

With Managed Kubernetes (NKE), the Horizontal Pod and Cluster Autoscaler can scale things, provided they're configured. ⚙️

That's not a default setting, it needs the right configuration, and database/backend must not become the bottleneck either.

How ready is your infrastructure for the next spike?

#kubernetes #autoscaling #cloudnative #nine
